text: uh so the car is driving at me with w key lol and i have no camera spin around the car like i do player
resolution: Fixed three issues the user hit driving the vehicle handling lab. (1) 'Car drives at me with W': the chase cam locked orbit yaw to heading+180, which (per orbitalEye) put the eye in FRONT of the car so forward came toward the viewer. (2) 'No camera spin like the player': there was no look control at all. Both fixed by switching to a player-style user-orbit — a lookRef{yaw,pitch} dragged via GAME_INPUT.onCursorMove + a transparent input overlay (scroll dollies distance), with the orbit target following the car each frame; default yaw 0 sits behind the car and reset recenters. (3) 'Top speed low but still 38km/h': real physics bugs in GAME_DRIVING — the quadratic drag term was missing its dt (framerate-dependent) AND resistance was heavy enough that terminal velocity (~10.5 m/s ≈ 38 km/h) sat below the topSpeed clamp, so the clamp never engaged and the knob did nothing. Added ·step to drag, lightened rollResist 0.9→0.4 / drag 0.0026→0.0008, raised enginePower 11→14 so terminal exceeds topSpeed and the clamp is the real cap; lowering top speed now lowers max speed. Verified: bundles clean with full @game+runtime resolution.
